description:
The guys at the Adventist History Project (@AdventistHistory) decided to mention our platform in a video regarding the Trinity in Adventist history. Wherein we saw, once again, many of the standard defenses, dodges, and claims that Adventism was misrepresented regarding the Trinity versus the "Heavenly Trio." We will wade through all the strawmen and red herrings to show, yet again, who is and isn't misrepresenting things and who has and hasn't done their homework.

Funeral for Heresy: The SDA Pioneers on the Trinity | https://www.youtube.com/live/a3ZnHZ4Y-94?si=PaBStBBGVzsriVqg

Video in review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D74iL_AVyMo
